buttons.name: Move Left
buttons.command: crelay 2 OFF && sleep 1 && crelay 2 ON && sleep 1 && crelay 2 OFF
buttons.confirm:
Roof can be closed only if the telescope is in parking position.
Do you really want to move the roof?

buttons.name: Move Right
buttons.command: crelay 1 OFF && sleep 1 && crelay 1 ON && sleep 1 && crelay 1 OFF
buttons.confirm:
Roof can be closed only if the telescope is in parking position.
Do you really want to move the roof?

buttons.name: Move Both
buttons.command: crelay 1 OFF && crelay 2 OFF && sleep 1 && crelay 1 ON && crelay 2 ON && sleep 1 && crelay 1 OFF && crelay 2 OFF
buttons.confirm:
Roof can be closed only if the telescope is in parking position.
Do you really want to move the roof?
